name: Bulbasaur
description: A favourite pick among adventurers for its navigation, resourcefulness and stylish green hat.

name: Ivysaur
description: Its keen eyesight makes it an exceptional scout, warning allies of danger long before it arrives.

name: Venusaur
description: A master survivalist whose arrows strike with flawless precision while guiding allies safely through the wild.

name: Charmander
description: Jack of all trades, master of none. Its vast repertoire can aid adventurers in any situation of combat.

name: Charmeleon
description: It studies both healing and battle, blending supportive magic with swift techniques learned in combat.

name: Charizard
description: A wise mage highly erudite in the tales and strategy of combat. Touching its robe can instantly purge your ailments.

name: Squirtle
description: It stores static charge in its body, releasing small electric shocks while gliding across frozen seas.

name: Wartortle
description: Its charged flippers strike like bolts, sending currents through icy waters to stun nearby prey at once.

name: Blastoise
description: The ruler of frozen coastlines. It commands lesser penguins through sheer strength and authority.

name: Sprigatito
description: A nimble and cunning Pokémon that scurries through dense forests, using its sharp claws to climb trees with ease.

name: Floragato
description: A territorial rodent that dominates forest canopies, gnawing through thick branches to build sprawling nests.

name: Butterfree
description: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses electric attacks.

name: Charcadet
description: A gargantuan bird that has control over lightning. It's said it was the guardian deity of a forgotten forest tribe.

name: Armarouge
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Ceruledge
description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Pidgey
description: It was discovered in an aquatic ruin off the shores of Lemuria. It can breathe etheric energy in lieu of air.

name: Pidgeotto
description: An ancient serpent from ruined seas. It exhales corrosive ether that erodes both mind and flesh.

name: Pidgeot
description: It thrives for damp, shadowy forests. Too much exposure to its spores can leave one lost in a waking dream for hours.

name: Rattata
description: An enigmatic fighter that lurks in misty woodlands and releases hypnotic spores to trap its victims in endless dreams.

name: Ratreecate
description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Spearow
description: It's only active during daytime. It lures prey with its warm radiance before ensnaring them in fiery vines.

name: Fearow
description: Each coconut contains a core of  compressed energy. When threatened, it splits open and detonates.

name: Ekans
description: When provoked, it fires explosive coconuts with pinpoint accuracy, flattening anything in their path.

name: Arbok
description: New explorers were given a warning about this strong and territorial F.O.E. However, many did not listen.

name: Pikachu
description: From the moment it is born, it places itself between others and danger, like a newborn reflex.

name: Raichu
description: It scraps bits of Magnemite and turns it into sturdy metals to enhance its armor and hammer.

name: Sandshrew
description: An ironclad rampart that defends the weak from all harm and smites evil with the thump of its hammer.

name: Sandslash
description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It might become a great leader in the future.

name: Nidoran
description: Imbued with etheric energy, this soon-to-be monarch is ready to guide its allies to victory.

name: Nidorina
description: Its royal orders have the power to raise the morale of its allies and turn the tide of the battle.

name: Nidoqueen
description: A mighty and commanding general who decimates its foes with its dual-wielding sword style.

name: Nidoran
description: The stone on Mareep's forehead grants it the power to look into the dreams of humans and Pokémon.

name: Nidorino
description: When Flaaffy sleeps, it visits the dreams of others. If a dream is sweet enough, it gets devoured.

name: Nidoking
description: Incapable of controlling its hunger, it puts people and Pokémon to sleep in order to eat their dreams.

name: Clefairy
description: It sings lullabies to soothe both crops and creatures. It's said that its voice helps plants grow lush and healthy.

name: Clefable
description: It nurtures land and listeners using its soothing voice. Its lullabies can leave adventurers napping in the fields.

name: Vulpix
description: A primitive flightless bird that roams ruins and forests in paired unity, running in sudden frantic bursts.

name: Ninetales
description: An ancient avian that roams the land. Its three heads act in perfect sync, striking with overwhelming speed.

name: Jigglypuff
description: At birth, its mother gave it a warm, colorful and soft hat that remains with it always.

name: Wigglytuff
description: The chanting of its runes can send chills to even the most cold-resilient opponents.

name: Zubat
description: Its unrivaled magical prowess lets it weave the elements into cataclysmic spells with ease.

name: Golbat
description: It weaves thin binding threads between ruins and forest roots, trapping prey in silent ambushes.

name: Oddish
description: Its massive webbing spreads wide across ancient tunnels and paths, ensnaring foes in unbreakable silk.

name: Gloom
description: Machop hones its body through hand-to-hand combat. Its fists strike with bone-crushing force.

name: Vileplume
description: Its punches are so powerful that they create shockwaves capable of shattering even the toughest defenses.

name: Paras
description: It can unleash a relentless barrage of strikes, generating shockwaves strong enough to reduce mountains to rubble.

name: Parasect
description: It harnesses both mind and body in perfect harmony, allowing it to battle fiercely and heal its allies.

name: Venonat
description: It seamlessly blends martial prowess with spiritual healing while striving to reach true enlightenment.

name: Venomoth
description: Often found in arid regions. It curls into a ball for both attack and defense with its sturdy outer hide.

name: Diglett
description: Hooked claws allow it to tear away at earth and foe alike. It swims through desert terrain as if it were water.

name: Dugtrio
description: It does not only rely on sight, but its big red nose captures the odors of its target to guide the muzzle.

name: Meowth
description: Its highly developed nose tracks the slightest scent, making escape from its relentless barrage impossible.

name: Persian
description: Its body is made of some strange, bouncy material that can nullify impacts. It makes its nest near abandoned buildings.

name: Psyduck
description: It can swallow anything in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Golduck
description: Commonly spotted scavenging the shores, it consumes coins and scrap metal to grow its steely exoskeleton.

name: Mankey
description: Like a hydraulic press, its crusher claw can apply tons of pressure to anything too slow to evade its vice.

name: Primeape
description: Though still young, its loud cry can already shake the sea. Sailors and pirates fear its sudden charges.

name: Growlithe
description: It commands the oceans with its mighty roar. Its colossal size allows it to create devastating tidal waves.

name: Arcanine
description: An icy, six-legged horse with flames on its back. It usually creates its nest on mountains or snowy places.

name: Poliwag
description: An enormous, otherworldly, eight-legged stallion. Legends say it came from a place called Lagaard.

name: Poliwhirl
description: It plays by mimicking F.O.E.'s aura, glowing ominously in the dark just to scare passing travelers.

name: Poliwrath
description: It uses the flame on its head to drive children to the netherworld and devour their innocent, pure souls.

name: Pawmi
description: When it eats enough pure souls, Duskull evolves and gains enough power to manipulate the life force around it.

name: Pawmo
description: A guardian of the netherworld who can manipulate souls and life force at will. It can be seen in graveyards.

name: Pawmot
description: This insect is as fierce as it is beautiful. Its migratory path lies littered with frozen remains.

name: Machop
description: Swarms of Dustox will congregate within misty ravines. If disturbed, they'll make a storm of noxious dust.

name: Machoke
description: Agile and graceful, it dances through the battle with lightning-fast strikes. It loves bread.

name: Machamp
description: It carefully cultivates medicinal herbs, learning to distinguish beneficial plants from harmful ones.

name: Bellsprout
description: Tensions dissolve in the soothing scent of its herbs, and all present are drawn to its warm and tranquil vibe.

name: Weepinbell
description: A cunning herbalist that uses rare plants to heal allies or poison foes. It is revered for its wisdom.

name: Victreebel
description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Tentacool
description: It stalks prey through silent woods, moving on four silent paws. It learns to strike from the shadows.

name: Tentacruel
description: Now upright, it wields a small blade crafted from hardened claws of defeated enemies, attacking with swift cuts.

name: Geodude
description: A master of shadow and deception. It vanishes beneath its cloak and strikes with deadly accuracy before it is seen.

name: Graveler
description: A small rainbug that gathers moisture from forest canopies, spreading soft, healing mist.

name: Golem
description: It channels stormwater into wings, enhancing its strikes with rain and cleansing the battlefield.

name: Ponyta
description: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

name: Rapidash
description: It destroyed its own control mask. It has become capable of changing type by equipping special memories.

name: Slowpoke
description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Slowbro
description: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Magnemite
description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Magneton
description: A spirit wandering within ancient necropolises that devours souls to strengthen its mystic power.

name: Farfetch'd
description: A lich lord that controls fallen Trainers and Pokémon as its undead puppets for eternity. You may be next.

name: Doduo
description: It drifts through forests at dusk, carrying faint echoes of sorrow within its hollowed pumpkin body.

name: Dodrio
description: Seen as a messenger of Hell, it has become lonely. It shares its pumpkins with others in times of festivities.

name: Seel
description: It buries itself along mountain paths, ambushing prey from beneath rocks with sudden venomous strikes.

name: Dewgong
description: Feared throughout Jagged Reach, it crushes armored prey with claws strong enough to shatter stone.

name: Grimer
description: It scatters fragrant pollen around its territory to calm enemies and lure wandering Pokémon closer.

name: Muk
description: It releases dense clouds of pollen that numb the body and dull the mind, leaving prey unable to resist.

name: Shellder
description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Cloyster
description: It thrives deep within ancient forests, drawing nourishment from pure earth and watching over hidden paths.

name: Gastly
description: A Forest Mystic attuned to storms that channels lightning through its blooms to purge intruders from its domain.

name: Haunter
description: It boldly patrols its territory, driving away trespassers with fierce bursts of scorching flame.

name: Gengar
description: Its thunderous roar alone is enough to send enemies fleeing before it engulfs the battlefield in flames.

name: Onix
description: They form groups of 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-they will never let down a comrade.

name: Drowzee
description: Its gentle cry carries for miles, drawing the attention of unwary adventurers through the forest.

name: Hypno
description: It conceals itself among the trees, singing only when unsuspecting prey has wandered within striking range.

name: Krabby
description: This beautiful, winged creature uses its alluring voice to lure travelers to it, making an easy meal out of them.

name: Kingler
description: Though small and seemingly gentle, it fiercely protects its territory from anyone drawing too close.

name: Voltorb
description: Its massive claws can effortlessly tear through trees and thick armor when enraged by intruders.

name: Electrode
description: A monstrous beast feared in forests, it tracks prey relentlessly at night with overwhelming brutal strength.

name: Exeggcute
description: A guardian beast of a forgotten tribe. Master of wind and water, it swims through the air.

name: Exeggutor
description: It parasitizes other plants by fusing with their roots, while its scarlet eye scans the surroundings for threats.

name: Cubone
description: A horrifying, tentacular creature. It once caused mass panic, mistaken for the reincarnation of an otherworldly god.

name: Marowak
description: It's said it drives the snorkelers to tight spaces to immobilise and eat them once they're out of oxygen.

name: Hitmonlee
description: The scent released from its leaf contains dangerous bacteria capable of causing infections.

name: Hitmonchan
description: The toxic spores around its neck rapidly spread through the air, slowly weakening its victims.

name: Lickitung
description: The inhaled bacteria from its toxic breath can destroy human tissues and organs in the blink of an eye.

name: Koffing
description: It prowls through dense forests, silently stalking anything small that wanders into its territory.

name: Weezing
description: Its venomous tail lashes out with deadly precision, leaving weakened prey with little hope of escape.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Now armed with mighty wings, it swoops down on unsuspecting prey from the mountaintops to deliver deadly poison.

name: Rhydon
description: It is especially fond of Mareep, often sneaking into grasslands and farms to hunt the weakest of the flock.

name: Chansey
description: Once it locks its jaws on prey, it violently thrashes about until nothing remains intact.

name: Tangela
description: It grins widely as it stalks its prey. Then it tears them apart and devours them in a single gulp.

name: Kangaskhan
description: Its haunting hoots carry hypnotic power, making even the strongest minds succumb to sleep.

name: Horsea
description: With a single glance, this nocturnal bird can lull its prey into a deep, dreamless sleep.

name: Seadra
description: It basks in scorching desert heat, storing fire within its frill to ignite sudden defensive bursts.

name: Goldeen
description: A desert predator of blazing storms, it channels draconic flame currents into overwhelming incandescent speed.

name: Seaking
description: It plays its guitar on the lakeside to entertain its friends during summer nights. It usually performs in duo with Illumise.

name: Staryu
description: It dances gracefully whenever one of its friends needs to be cheered up. It usually performs in duo with Volbeat.

name: Starmie
description: It drifts across open sea, lakes and rivers by filling its body with air, escaping predators with ease.

name: Mr. Mime
description: An enormous sea serpent known for its violent rampages. Even the most daring of sailors steer clear of the Leviathan.

name: Scyther
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Jynx
description: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Electabuzz
description: It prowls the edges of settlements, using playful tricks and misdirection to slip away unnoticed.

name: Magmar
description: This panther-like Pokémon excels at stalking prey from the shadows. Its hunts end almost as soon as they begin.

name: Pinsir
description: It swings a short spear while training across hills and mountains. Its body hardens through battle.

name: Tauros
description: Its sharpened spear grows longer with every hard-fought victory. Few can match its spirit and endurance.

name: Magikarp
description: It channels its allies' mana through its spear, condensing it into one devastating blow that ends battles instantly.

name: Gyarados
description: Its sturdy shell grows tougher with every molt, protecting it from the fiercest predators.

name: Lapras
description: Few can pierce its massive shell, and even fewer survive the crushing force of its claws.

name: Ditto
description: It roosts in caves and deep woods, navigating by ultrasonic echoes to locate prey in total darkness.

name: Eevee
description: It hunts by locking onto heat and sound, draining strength from living targets with relentless biting attacks.

name: Vaporeon
description: It moves as a blur of wings and shadow, striking with surgical precision before its prey can react.

name: Jolteon
description: It anchors itself to the seabed, waiting patiently as currents pass through its grasping tendrils.

name: Flareon
description: A monster of the deep sea. The massive whirlpools it creates are responsible for sinking countless seafaring vessels.

name: Porygon
description: Its sturdy shell is constantly reinforced by layers of earth collected throughout its travels.

name: Omanyte
description: Wandering spirits are drawn to the rocky formations upon its shell without explanation.

name: Omastar
description: It stalks the border to the afterlife, growing larger with every soul that it traps in the obelisks on its back.

name: Kabuto
description: It crawls through soil and rotten wood, leaving behind a faint toxic trail that weakens anything it touches.

name: Kabutops
description: It curls into a spinning armored form, rolling through enemies like a wheel of poison and crushing force.

name: Aerodactyl
description: A massive predatory centipede beast. It charges at full speed through terrain spreading venom with every step.

name: Snorlax
description: Deeply connected to nature, Cubone summons the spirits of Pokémon to aid it in battle and protect its allies.

name: Articuno
description: Drawing strength from ancient spirits and primal instincts, it commands souls and nature alike in battle.

name: Zapdos
description: An entity born from ancient scrap metal that patrols tunnels and ruins while awaiting new orders.

name: Moltres
description: Three units now linked as one mind. No trepasser can go unnoticed within its 360-degree vision.

name: Dratini
description: It oversees ruined sectors deep beneath the surface, driving intruders away thanks to its control units.

name: Dragonair
description: It climbs steep cliffside paths, using its sure-footed hooves to traverse unstable ground.

name: Dragonite
description: A massive mountain climber beast. It carries travelers across cliffs with unmatched strength and balance.

name: Mewtwo
description: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey.

name: Mew
description: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.

name: Chikorita
description: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It's incredibly popular in very hot regions.

name: Bayleef
description: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Meganium
description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Cyndaquil
description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Quilava
description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Typhlosion
description: A trainee ninja that's studying the art of ninpo to become stronger. It's able to create duplicates of itself.

name: Totodile
description: It hides in shadows and uses the art of ninpo to catch its prey by either poisoning or paralyzing them.

name: Croconaw
description: With an unwavering gaze, this ancient protector stands vigilant over sacred lands, warding off any intruders.

name: Feraligatr
description: An ageless guardian said to watch over forbidden ruins. Its elemental masks can deflect any attack that comes its way.

name: Sentret
description: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.

name: Furret
description: It whispers dreadful incantations that cloud the minds of its foes and fill them with creeping fear.

name: Hoothoot
description: A vengeful caster of mind-controlling and debilitating hexes that slowly deteriorate its enemies.

name: Noctowl
description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Ledyba
description: Provoking this timid catfish will make it flee. However, it can become incredibly vicious when cornered.

name: Ledian
description: A small bird whose wings are made of plasma. It's said it can control small amounts of Etheric energy.

name: Spinarak
description: A Magician who can manipulate the Etheric energy of the stars. It has complete control over multiple elements.

name: Ariados
description: It skillfully fights with two blades, training day and night to master swift and precise sword techniques.

name: Crobat
description: Dancing seamlessly with more swords than most can wield, its slashes blossom into a storm of cuts.

name: Chinchou
description: It eagerly studies forgotten tomes, fascinated by the mysteries of arcane spells and arts.

name: Lanturn
description: Its growing mastery of magic allows it to conjure lances of mana that pierce even the strongest foes.

name: Pichu
description: Having reached the pinnacle of arcane mastery, it has earned the revered title of Omnimancer.

name: Cleffa
description: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles.

name: Igglybuff
description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do anything.

name: Togepi
description: It spends most of its time asleep, looking harmless to passing foes. A rude awakening sparks lightning.

name: Togetic
description: Its body stores immense voltage while it peacefully slumbers. Few survive its sudden outburst.

name: Natu
description: It charges headfirst at anything that enters its territory, smashing stone walls with reckless force.

name: Xatu
description: Its monstrous strength allows it to shatter armor effortlessly. Its scales are as hard as stone. Best left alone.

name: Mareep
description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Flaaffy
description: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Ampharos
description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Bellossom
description: A small solitary wasp-like creature. It tirelessly gathers nectar while following its instinct to find a hive.

name: Marill
description: A sovereign that rules hive colonies, commanding its swarm with strict and unyielding discipline.

name: Azumarill
description: It darts through dense woodlands. Its agile flight allows it to evade nearly every would-be predator.

name: Sudowoodo
description: Its razor-sharp wings slice the air, striking prey with blinding speed before vanishing into the forest.

name: Politoed
description: It eats iron to build its steel body in order to protect its allies. It has a great sense of honor.

name: Hoppip
description: It eats metals to strengthen its golden armor. When someone's in danger, it's the first to jump into action.

name: Skiploom
description: Its arms are covered by huge golden scales that resemble a shield. Its body has no blind spots.

name: Jumpluff
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. Some religions consider it to be the child of the celestial judge.

name: Aipom
description: A beast worshipped as the messenger of the gods during ancient times. It controls lightning at will.

name: Sunkern
description: It carries a small medkit box, eager to help the wounded it finds on its gentle, wandering path.

name: Sunflora
description: It stores vital remedies within its soft pouch, tending the sick with calm and steady care.

name: Yanma
description: Those who pick on the ill are bludgeoned mercilessly by the hammer of this compassionate, egg-shaped healer.

name: Wooper
description: It eagerly wrestles other Pokémon, growing stronger with every journey alongside its wandering troop.

name: Quagsire
description: It charges first and thinks later. Surprisingly, this reckless strategy works far more often than it should.

name: Espeon
description: It scavenges old relics from ruins, fusing them into its armor to inherit the strength of the past.

name: Umbreon
description: A majestic beast whose strongest specimen is said to dwell upon Jagged Reach. Death awaits its challengers.

name: Murkrow
description: Quick to anger, it fearlessly charges anything that wanders too close, no matter how much larger it may be.

name: Slowking
description: It tears through forests in furious charges, leaving uprooted trees and shattered ground wherever it rampages.

name: Misdreavus
description: With its hair-trigger temper and its massive frame, it is more than capable of taking out entire squads at once.

name: Unown
description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: Wobbuffet
description: It playfully rolls along the shore, showing little fear of strangers that wander into its home.

name: Girafarig
description: It keeps a watchful eye over its colony, swiftly confronting anything that threatens its companions.

name: Pineco
description: Once roused to anger, its relentless assaults are powerful enough to drive entire hunting parties into retreat.

name: Forretress
description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Dunsparce
description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Gligar
description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Steelix
description: It innocently wanders flower fields, captivating passersby with a beauty few can resist.

name: Snubbull
description: Its graceful appearance conceals a sly and calculating nature, waiting for the perfect moment to act.

name: Granbull
description: One of very few Pokémon capable of human speech, yet it cannot be trusted. Beautiful, but cunning and vicious.

name: Qwilfish
description: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

name: Scizor
description: Its scythe-like arms strike with deadly precision. Those who glimpse its eyes rarely live to tell the tale.

name: Shuckle
description: Its many tentacles extend like grasping vines, siphoning life force from its surroundings to sustain its core.

name: Heracross
description: An ancient predator whose tentacles drain the life force from the surroundings, turning biomes into barren wastelands.

name: Sneasel
description: This massive wyrm hoists unlucky explorers into the skies, only to drop them into its nest for a gruesome feast.

name: Teddiursa
description: Often found aboard pirate ships, it mimics the crew's every move to hone its fighting skills.

name: Ursaring
description: A seasoned pirate that never misses an opening, overwhelming foes with a relentless barrage of shots.

name: Slugma
description: Its arm cannons are so powerful that pirate crews rely on them more than their own warship's guns.

name: Magcargo
description: It's an enigmatic but loyal Pokémon that appears to harbor an arcane power. It can be seen together with Ralts.

name: Swinub
description: Its dormant power has awakened, causing it to take on a draconic form. However, it's still far from reaching its peak.

name: Piloswine
description: Its body has shifted into a monstrous, berserk state, cloaked in crackling lightning and shadowy energy.

name: Corsola
description: It senses the thoughts around it, though it has yet to understand the strange power it possesses.

name: Remoraid
description: A mysterious priest of the deep. It dominates the minds of others through its overwhelming psychic power.

name: Octillery
description: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Delibird
description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Mantine
description: A miasma of impending doom shrouds its scythe. As a result, it's often mistakenly labelled as Deathbringer.

name: Skarmory
description: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger.

name: Houndour
description: Though it isn't particularly fast, Tyrunt boasts remarkable stamina. It hunts by chasing prey to exhaustion.

name: Houndoom
description: It tears through flesh with ease thanks to its razor sharp claws and fangs. Its saliva carries a potent paralytic.

name: Kingdra
description: Remarkably docile. One of the very rare Pokémon that can be approached safely, provided its parents aren't around.

name: Phanpy
description: Despite its peaceful nature, it may panic without warning, accidentally crushing anything in its path.

name: Donphan
description: It prowls coastal waters, attacking anything that draws its attention, even massive pirate ships.

name: Porygon2
description: It lurks beneath the waves, ambushing prey from the depths with sudden and brutal attacks.

name: Stantler
description: A terror of the deep seas. Its attacks are said to be strong enough to sink entire fleets with a single strike.

name: Ursaluna
description: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

name: Tyrogue
description: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Hitmontop
description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. They are covered in hard armor.

name: Smoochum
description: It spends countless hours training, never loosing an arrow without first carefully judging the battlefield.

name: Elekid
description: A seasoned archer whose mastery lets it adapt its techniques to aid its companions in any situation.

name: Magby
description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Orthworm
description: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can't yet fly.

name: Blissey
description: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

name: Raikou
description: Its cheerful songs echo across the shoreline, drawing the curious ever closer without realizing it.

name: Entei
description: It uses its graceful performance to distract opponents while its tentacles launch surprise attacks.

name: Suicune
description: A mesmerizing diva whose haunting voice lures prey into a false sense of safety before their final moments.

name: Larvitar
description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers.

name: Pupitar
description: It basks upon scorching rocks, storing intense heat within its body before spitting searing flames.

name: Tyranitar
description: The infernal heat of its body reduces even solid rock to slag as it relentlessly pursues its prey.

name: Lugia
description: Its cheerful smile puts others at ease, though its appetite is far greater than its tiny body suggests.

name: Ho-Oh
description: Don't be fooled by its friendly appearance! Quagsire is capable of swallowing prey whole in a single bite.

name: Celebi
description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body to serve as a decoy to distract the attacker.
Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an accomplished opponent.
It can detect the innate qualities of leadership. Whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.
A mass of unstable matter, it absorbs raw electrical storms that constantly reshape its form.
A condensed being of living charge, it erupts in violent thunder bursts that disintegrate anything nearby.
Static charge constantly builds within its soft body, releasing small sparks when startled.
Its body attracts thunderbolts, absorbing their power without harm to fuel its next attack.
It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
It quietly tends young forest blooms, drawing wandering creatures ever closer with its soothing fragrance.
A graceful dryad of ancient woods. It beguiles enemies with its beauty before entangling them in living vines.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
It fearlessly challenges anything larger than itself, relying on brute strength over careful strategy.
It silently ambushes its prey, ripping them apart with its massive claws before they can even retaliate.
It lurks within deep forest shadows, mischievously provoking intruders into wandering off their path.
It begins to assume a more sinister form, luring prey deeper into the woods before striking with sudden cruelty.
A towering ogre living in small groups with Roserade and Hawlucha. It defends its domain with brute strength.
It eagerly studies the elemental arts, though its spells produce only small and often unstable bursts of power.
It casts spells by imbuing its gauntlets with elemental energy, striking foes with blazing speed and precision.

name: Treecko
description: Its mastery of the elements reached beyond what was thought possible, awakening an unknown force within.

name: Grovyle
description: A nimble vanguard that charges towards the enemy before all of its allies to create an opening.

name: Sceptile
description: It excels at breaking enemy lines, following every opening it creates with swift and relentless attacks.

name: Torchic
description: Every swing of its blade is guided by flawless teamwork, making it a fearsome ally in any battle.

name: Combusken
description: Beware. Despite its cute appearance, it can transform into dangerous F.O.E.s within the vicinity.

name: Blaziken
description: A master of the art of deception, it shifts its form into towering F.O.E.s that break the will of enemies.

name: Mudkip
description: Its closed forehead eye conceals a dormant power destined to awaken once it reaches full maturity.

name: Marshtomp
description: The eye upon its brow unveils every thought hidden in the mind of its enemies, making escape impossible.

name: Swampert
description: Thanks to its coloration, it blends in with the seafloor to evade predators within the Lemurian sea.

name: Poochyena
description: It flicks shards of itself at anyone who leaves trash nearby. Later, shards may become new Corsola.

name: Mightyena
description: It moves with graceful precision, using swift strikes to exploit the smallest opening in defense.

name: Zigzagoon
description: Its slicing blows are faster than the eye can perceive, leaving only the sound of the wind behind.

name: Linoone
description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

name: Wurmple
description: Small but surprisingly fearless, it boldly challenges intruders despite its tiny stature.

name: Silcoon
description: Its blazing feathers grow brighter with every victorious battle, warding off even larger foes.

name: Beautifly
description: This gargantuan bird strikes fear into the hearts of the weak. It's feathers can burn foes and absorb lightning.

name: Cascoon
description: The King of Beasts and ruler of the  Primitive Jungle. It may attack by throwing Sandshrew at its enemies.

name: Dustox
description: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Lotad
description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form.

name: Lombre
description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Ludicolo
description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Seedot
description: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

name: Nuzleaf
description: A Forest Mystic attuned to storms that channels lightning through its blooms to purge intruders from its domain.

name: Shiftry
description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Nincada
description: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

name: Ninjask
description: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

name: Shedinja
description: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

name: Taillow
description: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

name: Swellow
description: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

name: Shroomish
description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Breloom
description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Spinda
description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

name: Wingull
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. The energy that its core absorbs allows it to live.

name: Pelipper
description: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: Surskit
description: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Masquerain
description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Wailmer
description: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

name: Wailord
description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Skitty
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Delcatty
description: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

name: Kecleon
description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Baltoy
description: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

name: Claydol
description: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nosepass
description: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Torkoal
description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Sableye
description: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Barboach
description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Whiscash
description: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

name: Luvdisc
description: Growing out of the bug's back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

name: Corphish
description: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

name: Crawdaunt
description: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

name: Feebas
description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Milotic
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Carvanha
description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Sharpedo
description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Trapinch
description: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Vibrava
description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Flygon
description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

name: Makuhita
description: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

name: Hariyama
description: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

name: Electrike
description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Manectric
description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Numel
description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Camerupt
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Spheal
description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Sealeo
description: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

name: Walrein
description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

name: Cacnea
description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. Graveler may come rolling down the path without slowing.

name: Cacturne
description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

name: Snorunt
description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Glalie
description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Lunatone
description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Solrock
description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Azurill
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Spoink
description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

name: Grumpig
description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Plusle
description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Minun
description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

name: Mawile
description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Meditite
description: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

name: Medicham
description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took  away a child it hypnotized.

name: Swablu
description: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly SelfDestruct.

name: Altaria
description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of The Bomb Ball.

name: Kingambit
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Duskull
description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Dusclops
description: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: Roselia
description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Slakoth
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Vigoroth
description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using Comet Punch.

name: Slaking
description: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

name: Gulpin
description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Swalot
description: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

name: Tropius
description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: Whismur
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Loudred
description: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

name: Exploud
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Clamperl
description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: Huntail
description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

name: Gorebyss
description: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

name: Absol
description: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

name: Shuppet
description: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

name: Banette
description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Seviper
description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Zangoose
description: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

name: Relicanth
description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Aron
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

name: Lairon
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

name: Aggron
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

name: Castform
description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

name: Volbeat
description: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

name: Illumise
description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Lileep
description: A Pokémon of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

name: Cradily
description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Anorith
description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Armaldo
description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Ralts
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Kirlia
description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

name: Gardevoir
description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Bagon
description: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely increase.

name: Shelgon
description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

name: Salamence
description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Beldum
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Metang
description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Metagross
description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

name: Regirock
description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Regice
description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Registeel
description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Kyogre
description: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

name: Groudon
description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Rayquaza
description: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world  to make more offspring.

name: Latias
description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Latios
description: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

name: Jirachi
description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: Deoxys
description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Chimecho
description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Bad Egg
description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Unown B
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Unown C
description: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

name: Unown D
description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: Unown E
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Unown F
description: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

name: Unown G
description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Unown H
description: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Unown I
description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Unown J
description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its Bite is powerful.

name: Unown K
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Unown L
description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Unown M
description: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Unown N
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

name: Unown O
description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Unown P
description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Unown Q
description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

name: Unown R
description: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow Octillery.

name: Unown S
description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

name: Unown T
description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Unown U
description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Unown V
description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Unown W
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Unown X
description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Unown Y
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

name: Unown Z
description: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: Unown !
description: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Unown ?
description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Turtwig
description: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Grotle
description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Torterra
description: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Chimchar
description: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

name: Monferno
description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Infernape
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Piplup
description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Prinplup
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Empoleon
description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Starly
description: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

name: Staravia
description: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

name: Staraptor
description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

name: Bidoof
description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

name: Bibarel
description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: Kricketot
description: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Kricketune
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Shinx
description: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

name: Luxio
description: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

name: Luxray
description: It can be seen with a pack of Poochyena, of which it's the leader. Many adventurers have fallen prey to its cold fangs.

name: Budew
description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

name: Roserade
description: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

name: Cranidos
description: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

name: Rampardos
description: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

name: Shieldon
description: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Bastiodon
description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Burmy
description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Wormadam
description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Mothim
description: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging Pidgey.

name: Combee
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Vespiquen
description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Pachirisu
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Buizel
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Floatzel
description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Cherubi
description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Cherrim
description: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Shellos
description: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Gastrodon
description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: Ambipom
description: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

name: Drifloon
description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Drifblim
description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Buneary
description: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Lopunny
description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Mismagius
description: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Honchkrow
description: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

name: Glameow
description: It emits a variety of sounds from the  holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

name: Purugly
description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Chingling
description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Stunky
description: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

name: Skuntank
description: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

name: Bronzor
description: The favorite of trend-conscious female Trainers, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

name: Bronzong
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Bonsly
description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Mime Jr.
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Happiny
description: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

name: Chatot
description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

name: Spiritomb
description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Gible
description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Gabite
description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Garchomp
description: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

name: Munchlax
description: No two Spinda are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

name: Riolu
description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Lucario
